table.description: table0:index of one lsc table in the first compensation table,table1:index of another lsc table in the first compensation table

max_CT.description: maximum value of color temperature range of the first compensation table

min_CT.description: minimum value of color temperature range of the first compensation table

table.description: table0:index of one lsc table in the second compensation table,table1:index of another lsc table in the second compensation table

max_CT.description: maximum value of color temperature range of the second compensation table

min_CT.description: minimum value of color temperature range of the first compensation table

mid_table_idx.description: In lsc table0~5, the compensation table Index with the G/R attenuation degree in the middle

mode.description: Colorless module mode selection, 0: off 1: on

lambda_r.description: Control the compensation range of color shading of R channel, the larger the value, the easier it is to be judged as shading

lambda_b.description: Control the compensation range of color shading of B channel, the larger the value, the easier it is to be judged as shading

weight_r.description: Control the compensation degree of color shading of R channel

weight_b.description: Control the compensation degree of color shading of B channel

mode.description: Post shading gain mode selection, 0: off 1: on

sample_y.description: Suppression coefficient, 0:means lsc gain is reduced to the minimum value of 1024, 1024:means maintaining the input lsc gain unchanged

flash_mode.description: Flash module mode selection, 0: off 1: on

flash_calc_freq.description: Calculation frequency of the algorithm library in flash mode

use_flash_cali_table.description: Whether to use the flash calibration table

preflash_gain_weight.description: Pre-flash lsc gain suppression ratio, when the value is 0, the suppression degree is the maximum, and the lsc gain is compressed to the minimum value of 1024, when the value is 1024, no suppression, keep the previously calculated lsc table

flash_capture_evRatio.description: Flash light source to ambient light ratio

flash_postpro_weight.description: 0 means the maximum suppression degree, that is, LSC gain is compressed to the minimum value of 1024, 1024 means the minimum suppression degree, that is, LSC gain is not suppressed and the calculation result of the previous step is maintained

flash_enhance_ratio.description: The percentage of flash lsc gain improvement, for example, 50 means lsc gain is improved by 50%

flash_center_shiftx.description: Set the center position of flash lsc gain improvement

flash_center_shifty.description: Set the center position of flash lsc gain improvement

lsc_cali_table.description: Table calibrated under this light source
